svg.title: Measured repository telemetry
svg.desc: Measured telemetry: 55 public non-fork repositories, 870 commits on default branches, and a language distribution of TypeScript 64.2 percent, JavaScript 17.0 percent, HTML 11.5 percent, CSS 3.4 percent, with 3.9 percent across all other languages, measured over 3.86 MB of public source on 2026-08-23.
